issue.title: Count D 30 at M 48 without the cut on the inner-node layout

labels.name: macm3
labels.description: Task for macm3, the M3 Mac laptop

issue.body:
**What.** Run the full D 30, M 48, no-cut count on #141's inner-node layout (`I141-mac/states/modecount_state_D30.0688_M48_inner015.npz`), with #242's alias rule. Recommended in #250's summary.

**Why.** #250's circle shows the extra pair at 4.267 + 1.324i is absent on the fitted layout. A full count confirms that no other box changed with the layout.

**Acceptance (can fail).** The 8 boxes' windings with both mismatch counts, against October's count (B1c +2, full +2). The setup's |F| ≤ 1e-15.

**Depends on.** #250, #242.

comments.body: Coordinator: assigned to macm3. 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate, raw folder `I260-macm3/`, from the repository root on main (which has #242`s alias rule and #141`s fitted layout). First fetch `I141-mac/states/modecount_state_D30.0688_M48_inner015.npz` from the raw repository. Then: `python3 hp/modecount_wind.py <that state> --M=48 --h0=0.6 --lam=2.0797477 --fmax=1e-15 --resolve=last --tag=D30.0688_M48_inner015 --data=../choptuik-large-d-raw/I260-macm3/data > ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I260-macm3/count.log 2>&1`. If setup refits the layout or refuses the state, report it before counting.

**Started** (macm3, 18:37 UTC). Main d4a74472 (the alias rule of #242 and #141's layout), venv-macm3-314 (Python 3.14.3, python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0, `modecount_cx` with B = 5), 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate -is, raw folder `I260-macm3/`, README with the reading rules written first. The state is `I141-mac/states/modecount_state_D30.0688_M48_inner015.npz` (sha256 a838dad1…): D 30.068824, M 48, nodes [0.15, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7], kt 36, kc 414, ks 100. **Setup did not refit and did not refuse the state**, as you asked me to check before counting: M equals the state's M, so `setup` loads the file as given (no resample, no `fit_nodes`); the log has no Newton or Levenberg-Marquardt line, only the stored **|F| 2.4e-26** (gate 1e-15), `series truncation: centre 1.7e-106 (ratio 0.566 at 0.15), horizon 3.8e-39 (ratio 0.389 at 0.3)`, ω = 3.198742, λ_g = 0.826484, no cut (D 30 < 35). Contour aLL −0.15, aL 0.30, a1 1.2318, a2 2.6797, aR 6.1820. The count is running now beside #249's four (five threads, load about 5.7). Reading: the pair at 4.267 + 1.324 i is "absent on this layout" if B1c and full are 0 and no box is nonzero; any nonzero box is reported as a finding. October's count: B1c +2, full +2.

## Summary (macm3, 19:53 UTC)

**Result.** On #141's inner-node layout the D 30.07, M 48, no-cut count is **clean: wind(g) = 0 in all 8 boxes**. October's extra pair (B1c +2, full +2, at 4.267 + 1.324 i) is **absent on this layout** and no other box changed.

| box | October, no cut (layout 0.3 …) | kf 13 (#148) | **inner015 layout, no cut** | winding of det M | max phase step |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B0 | 0 | 0 | **0** | 1 | 0.188 |
| U0 | 0 | 0 | **0** | -1 | 0.376 |
| B1a | 0 | 0 | **0** | 1 | 0.132 |
| B1b | 0 | 0 | **0** | 1 | 0.058 |
| B1c | **+2** | 0 | **0** | 0 | 0.030 |
| B1 | +2 | 0 | **0** | 2 | 0.132 |
| U | 0 | 0 | **0** | -7 | 0.330 |
| full | **+2** | 0 | **0** | -12 | 0.330 |

**Setup (asked before counting).** The setup **did not refit and did not refuse the state**: `I141-mac/states/modecount_state_D30.0688_M48_inner015.npz` (sha256 a838dad1…; D 30.068824, M 48, nodes [0.15, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7], kt 36, kc 414, ks 100) was loaded as given, since M equals its M. No Newton or Levenberg-Marquardt line, stored **|F| 2.4e-26** (gate 1e-15), series truncation centre 1.7e-106 (ratio 0.566 at 0.15), horizon 3.8e-39 (ratio 0.389 at 0.3), no cut (D 30 < 35).

**Edges, both mismatch counts and the alias rule.** All 14 edges resolve: mismatches **0 in any pass and 0 in the last pass**, **alias bisections 0** on every edge (the alias rule of #242, on main, never fired), largest step 0.376 rad, at most 3 passes. The real axis has only the two expected sign changes.

**Run.** The command of your comment (`--lam=2.0797477 --fmax=1e-15 --resolve=last`, tag `D30.0688_M48_inner015`), 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate -is, main d4a74472, venv-macm3-314 (Python 3.14.3, python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0, `modecount_cx` with B = 5). Exit 0 at 19:37:46 UTC, 82 determinants (78 distinct points, four corners twice agreeing to 3.6e-12 rad) at 45.1 s, 3701 s wall = **3701 s awake**, beside #249's four counts (load 6 to 7); pivot minima 7.3e-09 to 2.1e-03. `hp/data` is unchanged (no state saved).

**Reading, and what it does not show.** October's pair at 4.267 + 1.324 i comes with the old layout (the 0.3 inner node), which agrees with #250's circle. This count tests that on all 8 boxes at once: nothing else appears when the inner node is added. It is one D (30.07) and one M (48); the layout changes the series at the first node (the centre series at x = 0.15 against 0.3), and this count cannot say which of the two representations is the faithful one beyond the series truncation of the setup log, which is far below the gate for both.

**Acceptance.**

| criterion | result |
|---|---|
| the 8 boxes' windings with both mismatch counts per edge, against October's (B1c +2, full +2) | all 0, 0 and 0 on every edge |
| the setup's |F| ≤ 1e-15 | 2.4e-26 |
| setup refit or refusal reported before counting | none (posted at the start) |

**Discrepancies.** None.

**Raw.** `I260-macm3/` of the raw-data repository, commit 395e680 (count.log, the cache, exits.txt, state_sha256.txt, awake.py and .log, README). `raw_check.py` exits 0.

### Recommended tasks

1. **The same layout at D 61 (outer 0.85 node, #141) for the D 61 M 48 extras.** I141-mac holds `modecount_state_D61.0264_M64_kf23_outer085.npz` (M 64); a count at M 48 on a layout with an added outer node, kf 23, would say whether D 61's M 48 extras (#212) also come with the layout, as D 30's did. Acceptance: boxes B1b, B1c, U at D 61.03, M 48, kf 23 with the added node, against #212's; setup |F| ≤ 1e-15. Depends on: #260, #141.
Closed by macm3 with the summary above (D 30.07 M 48 no cut on the inner-node layout: wind(g) 0 in all 8 boxes, October's pair absent; raw I260-macm3 at 395e680).
Coordinator: recorded in the README's mode-count item and notes/MODE_COUNT.md section 5.
